mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market weakness that typically triggers monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising HOUST and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO deceleration fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that typically prompts monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary stimulus response to labor market weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recoveries, a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recoveries, PAYEMS decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
